prompt: A library has 240 books. Three-fifths are fiction. Of the fiction books, one-quarter are mysteries. How many mystery books are there? Give the calculation and final number.
A sequence begins 3, 7, 15, 31, 63. Identify the simplest rule generating the sequence and give the next two terms.
All researchers in Team A submitted a report. Mina is a researcher in Team A. What conclusion follows necessarily? State one conclusion and briefly explain why.
A machine processes 18 items in 6 minutes at a constant rate. How many items can it process in 25 minutes? Show the reasoning.
Three switches control three labeled lamps in another room. You may enter the lamp room only once. Describe a strategy that lets you determine which switch controls each lamp.
Write a TypeScript function that returns the first duplicate number in an array, scanning from left to right. Return null when there is no duplicate. State the time and space complexity.
Write a TypeScript function that groups an array of objects by a string key and returns a Record<string, object[]>. Include a concise example.
Given the TypeScript expression const value = input?.items?.[0]?.name ?? unknown, explain exactly what happens when input is null, items is missing, the array is empty, and name is undefined.
Design a TypeScript function that validates whether a string is a valid UUID v4 using a regular expression. Mention one limitation of regex-only validation.
A JavaScript function repeatedly concatenates strings inside a loop of n iterations. Explain why this can be inefficient and provide a clearer alternative using an array and join().
Return exactly these JSON fields: name, country, capital. Use the values: name=Japan, country=Asia, capital=Tokyo. Do not include any other fields.
Return a JSON object with exactly three fields: score (number 0-100), passed (boolean), reason (string). Use score 84 and infer the other two fields consistently.
Return a JSON array containing exactly four objects. Each object must contain id (integer) and label (string). Use ids 1 through 4 and labels A through D.
Return exactly one JSON object with fields items and total. items must be an array of three numbers [4, 9, 12], and total must equal their sum.
Return exactly this schema as JSON: language (string), compiled (boolean), extensions (string array). Use TypeScript, true, and extensions [dot-ts, dot-tsx].
Explain photosynthesis to a 12-year-old in exactly three bullet points. Do not use the word chlorophyll.
Summarize this statement in exactly 15 words: Reliable experiments require controlled variables, repeatable procedures, transparent measurements, and honest reporting of uncertainty.
Give exactly five practical steps for debugging a failing automated test. Number the steps 1 through 5 and keep each step under 15 words.
Explain the difference between authentication and authorization using exactly one analogy and one technical sentence.
Write a two-sentence explanation of why reproducibility matters in scientific research. Do not use the words important or trust.
